content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 16 vacancies are available - 1 for Anaesthesiology & Critical Care, 1 for Burns & Plastic Surgery, 1 for Dermatology, Venereology & Leprology, 1 for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, 2 for General Medicine, 1 for General Surgery, 1 for Neurosurgery, 2 for Paediatrics, 1 for Pathology & Lab Medicine, 1 for Psychiatry, and 1 for Transfusion Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Senior Resident posts is 28th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Senior Resident posts at AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: There are a total of 16 vacancies available for the Senior Resident (Non DM/MCh.) posts at AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification required is MBBS/BDS/M.Sc., MD/MDS/MS/Ph.D., DM/DNB/M.Ch. as per the specific department requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for UR candidates is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The salary is as per Level 11 of the Matrix, with an entry pay of ₹ 67,700/- per month plus NPA and other allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for these posts.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these Senior Resident positions?
faq.answer: The job type is contract-based.
